note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a PER 3(1), Supreme Decree no. 004-97-IN 8(a), 15 (revoked by Law 27532 in 2001?); A06b PER 3(1), Supreme Decree no. 004-97-IN 8(a), 15 (revoked by Law 27532 in 2001?); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 2 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.
